reviews.title: CANNOT TAKE VIDEOS (and really bad help center)
reviews.text:
I cannot record videos on the Locket app. I have followed all the instructions you provided, but the issue persists.
The core problem is that the Locket app completely fails to request Microphone access from iOS. Because it never asks for the microphone permission, the app does not even appear in the iOS Microphone settings list, making it impossible to record videos.
Here is a list of everything I have already tried:
 Checked iOS Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone. (Locket is NOT on the list because it never requested access).
 Checked Screen Time settings to ensure Microphone changes are set to "Allow Changes".
 Completely deleted and reinstalled the app multiple times.
 Long-pressed the capture button to trigger the permission prompt, but no pop-up appears and nothing happens.
 Even performed a complete "Reset Location & Privacy" in my iPhone settings to clear any system bugs, but the app still fails to trigger the prompt.
Since I have literally reset my privacy settings and the issue still occurs, this is clearly a bug within the current version of the Locket app. It is failing to trigger the native iOS microphone permission request.
Please escalate this issue to your development/engineering team so they can look into this bug.

reviews.title: Ads????? Time to Go.
reviews.text: I would have given this 5* only 24 hours ago as I love this app as I’ve deleted all social media and feel this has been a great way to interact with my friends - until today when I saw an ad whilst scrolling and now I feel sick. All these apps and tech companies just remind me of that Black Mirror episode. Give us a good app, get more people on it, then slowly take away good features (like being allowed to create specific groups to send pics to), add annoying extra features like usernames and then like today start rolling in the ads. I’m so disappointed with Locket, I’ve recently gotten 5 people to join locket as I was telling them how cool and simple the app was and that it had no ads. The issue with ads on locket is that it’s simple interface makes ads way more intrusive and obvious then an ad on instagram or tik tok. I can see where this app will be going and within 10 years it will look like snapchats terrible mush of an app. This is a real shame for regular users of locket and the start of worse things to come. I will now start to phase this app out of my regular use like I’ve been able to do all the other rubbish social media apps.
